title: France and Morocco set for blockbuster World Cup showdown
summary: France face Morocco for a place in the World Cup semi-finals, with Les Bleus starting as favourites but expecting a tough test from Achraf Hakimi and his teammates. France 24 speaks to The Peninsula Qatar's Victor Bolorunduro about the key battles, the refereeing controversies surrounding the tournament and why it has still been one of the most entertaining…
